js: 'Chat voice WP9, live: voice mode on a dev copy with local models (scripts/dev-copy.sh): Parakeet on the CPU for speech-to-text (audio/parakeet-tdt-q8-0), Supertonic for the voice (audio/supertonic-3-q8-0), gemma4-e4b for the chat. The microphone is a fake one saying TTS clips on cue (scripts/drive/fake-voice.js; the clips from scripts/drive/make-voice-fixtures.py into target/chat-voice/fixtures/voice-de.js). The state walks idle → listening → thinking → speaking → idle with captions, both bubbles are written and equal the stored rows, a second utterance over the reply barges in and the stored cut follows the truncate at what was heard, ending at a word (WP9 review B), with no response.cancel of the page's own; stop talking sends the truncate first and a response.cancel only when the truncate did not stop the response (NIT 13), its stored cut ends at a word too; push-to-talk by Space, Esc ends every track; leaving mid-reply shows the cut reply once, read back in place after the gateway's close (WP11 UI m1, m2); under the dev copy's own GPU hold (its /api/op/hold_set, turned off again) a refused turn is one amber chip in the panel and in text chat (m6); and an Admin Chat thread offers no voice mode. It starts the models containers: run with --podman-guard "" and check `podman ps -a --filter name=lmgw-dev` afterwards. Run: scripts/ui-drive.py scripts/drive/chat-voice-realtime.json --token-file <dir>.token --mute-audio --podman-guard "" (nothing is audible).'

js: (() => { const Real = window.WebSocket; window.__sent = []; window.__recv = []; window.__full = {}; window.WebSocket = function (url, p) { const ws = p === undefined ? new Real(url) : new Real(url, p); if (String(url).includes('/v1/realtime')) ws.addEventListener('message', (e) => { try { const v = JSON.parse(e.data); if (v.type === 'lmgw.chat.frame' && v.event === 'delta') { window.__full[v.response_id] = (window.__full[v.response_id] || '') + (v.data && v.data.text || ''); return; } if (/delta$/.test(v.type)) return; window.__recv.push({t: performance.now(), type: v.type, rid: v.response_id || (v.response && v.response.id) || '', reason: v.response && v.response.status_details && v.response.status_details.reason || '', content: v.content, unheard: v.unheard}); } catch (_) {} }); return ws; }; Object.assign(window.WebSocket, {CONNECTING: 0, OPEN: 1, CLOSING: 2, CLOSED: 3}); window.WebSocket.prototype = Real.prototype; const send = Real.prototype.send; Real.prototype.send = function (d) { try { const v = JSON.parse(d); if (v.type !== 'input_audio_buffer.append') window.__sent.push({t: performance.now(), type: v.type}); } catch (_) {} return send.call(this, d); }; return 'recording the session'; })()
